title: Import AI 477: In which I tell the IMF the Singularity has begun
author: Jack Clark
summary: Welcome to Import AI, a newsletter about AI research. Import AI runs on arXiv, cappuccinos, and feedback from readers.
takeaways: I’ll develop my claim: For the last half century, most countries have dealt with falling research productivity while researcher headcount grows rapidly - ideas and inventions appear to be getting harder to find.

In this speech, I focused primarily on how humanity can share in the benefits of AI if we exercise proper foresight and restraint, and I’m going to be expanding on the stakes of the singularity and the risks that we’ll all face in coming issues.

My whole career has been defined by finding information that seemed important to the future of the world, then telling the world about that information.Two decades ago, I started my career as a journalist, focusing on data centers.
